topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's core themes regarding cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive fitness and drive clonal selection in tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cells
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate whether tumor initiation and progression depend on tissue-specific stem cell hierarchies and stemness properties.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how non-mutagenic inflammatory cues, paracrine signaling, and stromal support are necessary to permit malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Experimental Technologies for Mapping Tumors and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: It details sequencing, bioinformatics, and spatial omics methods used to investigate tumor evolution and cellular interactions in the lab.

topics.label: Integrated Evolutionary Model of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how mutational burden, cellular origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental factors combine to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the subsequent lecture on cancer therapies.
